body.description: Fields to change on the feature.

schema.description: Fields accepted when updating a feature. `IdBusiness` and `TypeFeature` are set at creation and read-only afterwards: sending either has no effect. `FamilyCharge`, `KeyCharge`, the creation and update stamps, and `Links` are computed by ProAbono.

Order.description: Display order among all features in offers and hosted pages.

IsVisible.description: Whether shown in offers and hosted pages.

StateLife.description:
Life state of a catalogue resource.

* `Ok` — active
* `ToModerate` — awaiting moderation
* `DisabledUser` — disabled by the user
* `DisabledSystem` — disabled by the system
* `DisabledModeration` — disabled after moderation
* `Deleted` — deleted
StateLife.title: StateLife

ReferenceFeature.description: Your identifier for this feature, shared between ProAbono and your application.

Metadata.description: Set of key/value pairs attached to the object, up to five keys. Writable at creation and on every update of the parent object. On an update, send a key with an empty value to unset that key, or send an empty value for `Metadata` to clear every key.
Metadata.title: Metadata
